body:
So I have been looking into Cannabidiol as a source of relief for my Bipolar, that I was diagnosed with. I just got out of a 3-day insane asylum thing where they diagnose you and put you on prescription drugs to make you not want to kill yourself :P
They put me on zyprexa but it makes me fat because I just don't even care anymore and oreos sound as good as a salad (?) it's weird. I found out about CBD randomly on the internet and began exhaustively researching its potential to treat bipolar, within a few minutes of that search I found a study that suggested that CBD was just as effective as a antipsychotic from Europe. So, I found some online and bought it. At 90 for a 6 month supply, I think it's worth the cash for sure. I got a 500 mg spray. Each pump is 1.5 mg of CBD, I took like five sprays so that's about 8 mg. Fuck. I am sooo stoned!!! It's awesome!!! I don't feel tripped out, and paranoid at all! It's like the happy part of weed has been taken out isolated for me to enjoy in sweet sweet serendipity! It's amazing.
Here's how I would describe the high:
Mellow
Grounded
Fuck yeah
Sensual
Entertained
Casual
Euphoric
Body High
Feels so fucking good!
This is like the best shit ever.
I could take this stuff every day for the rest of my life. Seriously. I thought that THC was important, but fuck that. CBD is where it is at!!!
